violations.text: The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was turned off at time of inspection. A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. PIC turned on at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/30/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the quaternary ammoinium sanitizing solution for the 3 bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 07/14/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine has an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 07/14/2026
A hand washing sink was used as a dump sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/18/2024

The establishment is lacking a thermometer to test food temperatures. Food temperature measuring devices shall be provided and be readily accessible for checking cooking, cooling, reheating, and hot/cold holding temperatures of time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. New Violation. Correct By: 08/01/2024

Tongs were stored on an unclean surface (bar mats) between uses. During pauses in food preparation, utensils must be stored on a clean surface or in a clean, protected location. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/18/2024
